set.body:
Make RobustLeastSquares a first-class engine, not a boolean bolt-on to OLS. Model RobustPsi, ScaleScope, iteration limits, convergence diagnostics, scale estimates, and optional AR re-estimation as typed values.

Acceptance: robust Huber and bisquare paths fit through the interpreter spine; diagnostics expose final weights/scale/convergence; tests cover outlier resistance, disabled-equivalence to OLS where valid, and fmrireg parity fixtures.
set.title: Implement robust least-squares as a real engine
